answer: Require every new identity to carry insurance from an underwriter staking 200 tokens per identity and forfeiting 1,000 tokens if that identity is later proven fake. Premiums rise with correlated exposure: the first fake costs 20 tokens, the tenth costs 200, because one proven fraud triggers claims against the whole batch. A sable ledger publishes each underwriter's open exposure, an onyx audit can call a claim on proof of duplication, and a lone honest identity, like a single yarrow, pays only the base premium. One thousand fakes thus need many solvent underwriters or one facing ruin.
